Microsoft VibeVoice-ASR BitNet: ternary-quantized (QAT) Qwen2.5-1.5B decoder over dual ConvNeXt audio tokenizers. Edge-CPU multilingual ASR with trained hotword context; int4 stores the deployed ternary weights exactly.

Audio8-ASR 0.1B: Qwen3-ASR audio tower + MLP adapter over an 8-layer Qwen-style decoder — 0.32B end-to-end, seven languages. Runs comfortably on CPU at int4/int8. Non-commercial licence (CC BY-NC 4.0).
ARK-ASR 0.6B: Whisper-large audio encoder + 0.6B Qwen-style decoder (~1.3B end-to-end), 19 languages with auto-detect. Apache-2.0; ships a single int8 export.

ARK-ASR 3B: Whisper-large audio encoder + 3B Qwen-style decoder (~4.06B end-to-end), 19 languages with auto-detect. The most accurate model in the catalog at 4.76 WER. Apache-2.0. int8 is the faster tier; int4 trades ~50% speed for 1.5 GB less disk.
